title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Entitlement Amounts and County Loan Limit Baseline
content:
Every eligible veteran holds a basic entitlement under the VA Home Loan Guaranty. For loans above 144,000 dollars, total entitlement is a percentage of the county loan limit. The baseline conforming loan limit for one-unit properties in calendar year 2026 is stated per program, as is whether a veteran with full entitlement has no maximum guaranteed loan amount.

## Figures by program

| Program | Basic entitlement (USD) | Total entitlement for loans above 144,000 (% of the county loan limit) | Baseline county loan limit, one-unit, 2026 (USD) | No maximum guaranteed loan amount with full entitlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 36000.00 | 25 | 832750.00 | Yes |

## Worked figure (hypothetical county)

For a county whose loan limit equals the 2026 baseline of 832750.00 dollars, total entitlement for loans above 144,000 dollars is 25 percent of 832750.00, that is 832750.00 multiplied by 25 and divided by one hundred, or 208,187.50 dollars.

## Points of reading

- The basic entitlement figure, 36000.00 dollars, is the same on all seven programs.
- The 832750.00 figure is the baseline limit for calendar year 2026; the county loan limit for a particular loan is the one recorded on that loan for its closing year.
